note: The REAL HITMAN content the mod reads from the player's own install while it runs. Nothing here is ever shipped in our upload. ioiHash = md5(ioiPath)[1:8] big-endian; all three were verified to match the actual files extracted from this PC's install (presentInInstall verified true on 2026-10-08). Discovery: Steam libraryfolders.vdf -> app 1659040 -> HITMAN 3 folder.

rows.purpose: contract Rat (Chongqing) - codename, location key, objectives with literal target names 'Hush', 'The Archivist'
rows.fallbackIfMissing: use contracts.json fallbackDisplayName values and show 'contract file unavailable' on the dossier

rows.purpose: contract Bulldog (Dartmoor) - codename, objectives 'Eliminate Alexa Carlisle', 'Find the Case File'
rows.fallbackIfMissing: use contracts.json fallbackDisplayName values and show 'contract file unavailable' on the dossier

rows.purpose: contract Llama (Mendoza) - codename, objectives 'Eliminate The Winemaker', 'Eliminate The Herald', 'Find Diana Burnwood'
rows.fallbackIfMissing: use contracts.json fallbackDisplayName values and show 'contract file unavailable' on the dossier

rows.purpose: find the HITMAN install folder itself (Melty does not pass it: role secondary)
rows.ioiPath: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\libraryfolders.vdf then every library's steamapps\common\HITMAN 3
rows.fallbackIfMissing: try registry-free guesses: D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\HITMAN 3, then show missing_notice if none opens

rows.purpose: in-game message when HITMAN is not installed (required by Melty's rule for secondary games)
rows.ioiPath: n/a - our own English text drawn by briefing_menu
rows.fallbackIfMissing: n/a - this row IS the fallback

rows.purpose: dossier target art (TileImage paths inside the three contract JSONs, e.g. images/contracts/bulldog/bulldog_tile.jpg -> .pc_gfx resource)
rows.ioiHash: computed at runtime from each TileImage
rows.fallbackIfMissing: v1 dossier is text-only; images enabled later (row stays presentInInstall=false and preflight strict mode allows it as documented v2)
